verdict.rationale: The docs say Codex cloud runs tasks in parallel in isolated environments, and each result can be reviewed via its summary and diff before you open a PR or apply it locally. Subagents can also split work and report back findings. However, nothing explicitly shows running multiple attempts of the same task and comparing them side by side to pick one. Missing for 10: documented multi-attempt (best-of-N) runs for a single task, a side-by-side comparison UI for selecting a winner, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
